arguments.command:
set -e
pwd
printf '\n## top-level git status\n'
git -C /root/.openclaw/workspace status --short --branch
printf '\n## nested git repos\n'
find /root/.openclaw/workspace -mindepth 2 -name .git -type d -prune | sed 's#/.git$##' | sort | while read d; do
  echo "### $d"
  git -C "$d" status --short --branch || true
  echo
 done
printf '\n## candidate runtime/temp files\n'
find /root/.openclaw/workspace -maxdepth 3 \( -type f \( \
  -name '*.log' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.temp' -o -name '*.cache' -o -name '*.pid' -o -name '*.out' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '.DS_Store' -o -name '*.swp' -o -name '*.swo' -o -name '*~' -o -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' -o -name '*.jpeg' -o -name '*.webp' -o -name '*.gif' \
\) -o -type d \( -name '.cache' -o -name 'tmp' -o -name 'temp' -o -name 'logs' -o -name 'dist' -o -name 'build' -o -name '__pycache__' -o -name '.pytest_cache' -o -name 'node_modules' \) \) | sort
printf '\n## untracked files summary\n'
git -C /root/.openclaw/workspace ls-files --others --exclude-standard | sort | sed -n '1,200p'
